description.zh: 查询的结束时间（时间戳）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp.

description.zh:
实例id。<props="china">可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_8_8.2aea3618RlSR9K)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
description.en: The instance ID. Call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the instance ID.

description.zh: 关键字，按照”%KeyWord%”模式搜索，不区分大小写。
description.en: The keyword. The search is performed in the \`%KeyWord%\` pattern and is not case-sensitive.

description.zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja。
description.en: The language of some returned parameters. The default value is en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间（时间戳）。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-dns-gtm-logs --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00 --keyword demo --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --start-timestamp 1516779348000 --end-timestamp 1516779348000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeDnsGtmLogs --region cn-hangzhou --Keyword demo --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00' --PageNumber 1 --StartTimestamp 1516779348000 --Lang en --EndTimestamp 1516779348000
